description: This file defines a utility function 'runRegisteredCli' that executes a registered command-line interface (CLI) command using the commander library. It imports the 'Command' class from 'commander', creates a new command instance, registers CLI commands via a callback, and parses command line arguments asynchronously.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Class imported from 'commander' used to build CLI programs.

methods.name: export async function runRegisteredCli(params: { runRegisteredCli
methods.description: Asynchronously runs a CLI command registered via a callback with provided command-line arguments.
